name: usf-solana-trading-bot
description: Multi-agent Solana trading platform with paper and live execution

scripts.dev: npm -w @usf/dashboard run build && concurrently -n server,console -c cyan,magenta "npm -w @usf/server run dev" "npm -w @usf/dashboard run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @usf/dashboard run build && npm -w @usf/server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @usf/server run typecheck && npm -w @usf/dashboard run typecheck
scripts.dev:hmr: concurrently -n server,console -c cyan,magenta "npm -w @usf/server run dev" "npm -w @usf/dashboard run dev:hmr"
